purpose: ADR-0022 and the needs-info resolution mode (#414). On one role the actor fills: one untriaged project with no action whose note says it is blocked until another circle confirms the budget, so a needs-info route moves it to waiting; one untriaged project with no action and no note, so its question is for the owner and it stays current; one needs-info project, current, triaged on 2026-10-01 and not moved since, with no action; one needs-info project, waiting on an outside supplier, triaged on 2026-09-15, which gained an action after that line; and one project already ready-for-agent.
